17th April 1916
Sir,
At 3 p.m. 16th inst, a meeting was held by the Fokienese community in their guild on Foochow Road for the purpose of devising ways and means to induce the military authorities to abandon their intention of sending northern troops to Fukien, such action being calculated to disturb the peace of that province. There were about 100 persons present, and one Wong Toh Sung 王篤生 acted as chairman. After a discussion lasting an hour and a half it was decided to send telegrams to Liu Kwan Yung, Naval Minister, to the Foochow Military and Civil Governors, to the Foochow Chamber of Commerce, pointing out the danger to which the presence of strange troops would expose the province and exhorting these people to use their influence with the Central Government and thus prevent the despatch of northern troops.
At 11 a.m. 16th inst, the City Magistrate entertained some forty members of the local gentry to tea in his yamen, and announced that he and General Yang had decided to avoid fighting in the neighbourhood of Shanghai. He and General Yang would accept full responsibility for the adequate protection of the people. He also stated that were it not for the good offices of Yu Yah Ching (余亞清) in exhorting him to abandon his evil intention, Chen Chi Mei would have burned and looted the Chinese City.
Having received information that the rebels are trying to convene a National Assembly at No. 203 Avenue Joffre in Frenchtown, the Central Government has sent a high official named Zee Sz Yoong 徐世榮 to Shanghai to try to prevent this. It is said that he is conferring with Wu Ting Fang and Tang Shao Yi.
It is reported that the situation in Soochow is critical. Four soldiers alleged to have connection with the rebels were shot at the Arsenal yesterday morning.
Five hundred troops arrived at Woosung by train at 6 a.m. 17th inst. These men came from the North, and it is said that more will follow.
It is reported that isolated cases of petty looting by the troops continue at Woosung.
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.
（批：Submitted on m.s. apl 17.）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

1916年4月17日
先生：
本月16日下午3时，福建籍社群在福州路的会馆举行会议，旨在策划方法与手段，劝说军事当局放弃向福建派遣北军的意图，因为此举预计会扰乱该省的安宁。约有100人出席，由王篤生担任主席。经过一个半小时的讨论，决定向海军总长刘冠雄、福州军政长官、福州总商会发电报，指出异省军队进驻将使该省面临危险，并敦促这些人利用其对中央政府的影响力，从而阻止北军的派遣。
本月16日上午11时，上海县知事在其衙门设茶点招待约四十位本地士绅，宣布他与杨将军已决定避免在上海附近地区发生战斗。他和杨将军将承担保护民众安全的全部责任。他还表示，若非余亞清从中劝说他放弃恶念，陈其美早已焚烧并洗劫了上海县城。
获悉反叛者试图在法租界霞飞路203号召开国民大会，中央政府已派遣一名名为徐世榮的高官前往上海，试图阻止此事。据说他正在与伍廷芳和唐绍仪商议。
据报道，苏州局势危急。昨天上午，四名据称与反叛者有联系的士兵在兵工厂被枪决。
本月17日上午6时，五百名士兵乘火车抵达吴淞。这些人来自北方，据悉后续还有更多部队到达。
据报道，吴淞仍有士兵零星进行小规模抢劫的情况。
您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席探长。
（批注：于4月17日以手稿提交。）
警务处总监
